answers: We are Fintech, a growing financial technology company serving mid-sized businesses. We want to grow without adding too much overhead, but our sales-to-delivery process is creating some problems.
We have around 70 employees and our annual revenue is between $10M and $25M. Sales, operations and delivery teams are mainly involved.

Information is spread across HubSpot, Slack and email, and some important decisions still depend on senior people. This can cause around 2–3 days of delay and 10–15 hours of waiting or rework on affected projects.

I can approve changes, but right now the team is not comfortable using AI in day-to-day work and we are not ready to make a major change to our current process. We would prefer to continue with the current way of working for now.

We are Fintech, a growing financial technology company serving mid-sized businesses. We want to grow without adding too much overhead, but our sales-to-delivery process is creating some problems.

We have around 70 employees and our annual revenue is between $10M and $25M. Sales, operations and delivery teams are mainly involved.
Where does the friction show up — for example across tools, handoffs, or senior decisions — and what delay or rework does that create?

Information is spread across HubSpot, Slack and email, and some important decisions still depend on senior people. This can cause around 2–3 days of delay and 10–15 hours of waiting or rework on affected projects.
Who can approve changes here, and how open is the team to changing the process or using AI day to day?

I can approve changes, but right now the team is not comfortable using AI in day-to-day work and we are not ready to make a major change to our current process. We would prefer to continue with the current way of working for now.
